portfolioProject.projectTitle: Healthcare CRM: Modernizing Patient Management & Virtual Appointments

roleAndDescription.projectDescription: I spearheaded the development of a custom **CRM** replacing **DentrixAscend** for **Total Health Dental Care**. I built the **Schedule** and **Virtuals** modules, integrating **Agora** for live video meetings [1, 2]. I focused on **clean architecture** and **real-time UI updates** using **React** and **TypeScript** to manage **15,000+ patients** [1, 3]. This system reduced daily operational labor through automation [2, 4].

achievements_&_metrics: **33% increase** in global re-appointments, adding **1000+ monthly appointments** [5, 6].
Processed **millions of dollars** in patient payments through custom production tools [5, 7].

portfolioProject.projectTitle: TroopHunter: Automated Lead Generation & SaaS Dashboard

roleAndDescription.projectDescription: I led all technical and executive aspects of this lead generation platform [8]. Using **Next.js** and **TypeScript**, I architected a performance-first dashboard that loads instantly [9]. I implemented **Node.js microservices** and managed the **DevOps pipeline** with **Docker** and **Kubernetes** [9, 10]. I prioritized **intuitive filtering** and high-performance UX using **GSAP** and **Framer Motion** [9, 11].

achievements_&_metrics: Delivered **instant dashboard load times** and highly responsive interfaces [9, 10].
Optimized end-to-end performance for maximum reliability and discovery speed [10].

portfolioProject.projectTitle: Real-Time Patient Booking Engine & Office Locator

roleAndDescription.projectDescription: I developed a high-conversion booking engine enabling patients to schedule appointments across multiple offices [1, 12]. I integrated **Mapbox GL** for interactive office selection and built a secure registration flow using **React** [12, 13]. The system synchronizes in real-time with the custom **CRM** and **DentrixAscend** [12]. I ensured **mobile-first responsiveness** and **accessibility** for diverse patient needs [14, 15].

achievements_&_metrics: Reduced **administrative work** for staff by automating scheduling flows [16].
Increased **patient satisfaction** and revenue by improving booking convenience [14, 15].

portfolioProject.projectTitle: Web3 Membership Platform: NFT-Gated Access & Voting

roleAndDescription.projectDescription: I architected the frontend for **GoldenDAO**, a Web3 platform for AAPI empowerment [17, 18]. I implemented **NFT-gated access** and exclusive event features using **React** and **Redux** [18, 19]. Using **GSAP**, I created sophisticated micro-interactions to enhance community engagement [19]. I collaborated on the roadmap for membership systems with **exclusive voting rights** [20].

achievements_&_metrics: Successfully launched the platform to advance **AAPI solidarity** in the Web3 space [20, 21].
Created an impactful UX through the integration of **real-world events** and digital initiatives [20].

portfolioProject.projectTitle: Honeydu: Zero-Fee Payment App for Creators

roleAndDescription.projectDescription: I built the UI for **Honeydu**, a fintech application enabling zero-fee payments for freelancers [17, 22]. Using **React** and **TailwindCSS**, I designed an intuitive interface for managing invoices and transfers [18, 22]. I focused on building **reusable components** and managing global state with **Redux** [18]. The app provides real-time financial insights and simplifies money management [23].

achievements_&_metrics: Simplified **money management** for creators, making tax season easier [23].
Boosted usability through a clean, **mobile-first interface** redesign [18, 21].

roleAndDescription.projectDescription: I optimized the digital presence for **Total Health Dental Care**, focusing on **performance** and **engagement** [24]. I implemented interactive brand stories using **GSAP** and **ScrollTrigger** [3, 25]. I reduced site load times by **40%** through **ImagesLoaded** and responsive asset management [5, 24]. I utilized **Mapbox GL** to display customized office location markers [25].

achievements_&_metrics: **40% reduction** in site load times through specialized performance tools [5, 24].
**30% increase** in user engagement via scroll-based animations and interactive features [5, 24].
